Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about our handcrafted ayurvedic botanicals, ingredients, orders, and delivery.

🍃

Products & Ingredients

Handcrafted Botanicals
01.What makes EarthGlaze soaps different from commercial soaps?
Unlike mass-manufactured soaps that strip skin with detergents and synthetic lathering agents, our soaps are 100% cold-processed using organic cold-pressed plant oils and traditional Ayurvedic herbal decoctions.
02.Are EarthGlaze products suitable for sensitive skin?
Yes, our Goat Milk Soap and Beetroot Balm are specifically formulated with hypoallergenic, gentle botanicals without synthetic fragrance.
03.How long does one artisanal soap bar last?
Because our soaps are cold-processed and cured for 4 weeks, one bar typically lasts 3 to 4 weeks with daily use when kept on a draining soap dish.
📦

Orders, Shipping & Care

Delivery & Ritual Guidance
04.Do you use palm oil or chemical hardeners?
No. We do not use palm oil, animal tallow, or chemical hardeners. Our firmness comes naturally from coconut oil, shea butter, and extensive air-curing.
05.How do I track my order after purchasing?
You will receive an instant SMS and email with your tracking number, and you can also track your parcel in real-time on our Track Order page.
